# Vendored libraries

- `qrcode.min.js` - [qrcode-generator](https://github.com/kazuhikoarase/qrcode-generator) 1.4.4
  (MIT License, (c) Kazuhiko Arase), downloaded from cdnjs. Used by
  `eventposter.js` to draw the ticket QR code locally in the browser
  (no network request, nothing is sent anywhere).
